{{Quote|Special Executive Rasmus Blys, CZ-198' overseer. Backstabber, kiss-off and one of the Corporate Quarterly's "Top 500 Managers to Watch".|[[Eva Kaayz]], describing Rasmus Blys|<ref name="titans">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Titans of Industry|[[CZ-198]]}}</ref>}}
'''Rasmus Blys''' was a [[Special Executive]] and biochemist of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] and was in charge of [[CZ-198]], one of Czerka's many product development facilities, one that Rasmus Blys built up himself. Blys was well educated on the subject of biochemistry and other sciences and had designed multiple award-winning Czerka patents in the usage of [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] and [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] to create biological weapons. He also created the deadly bioweapon, the [[Vigilant]] which became the last line of security on CZ-198.<ref name="Flashpoint" />

In [[3638 BBY]]<ref name="Date" />, when the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] decided to shut down and absorb the Czerka Corporation, Rasmus Blys, unlike many of his colleges who turned to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] for help, decided to stand his ground on CZ-198, independent from both sides. As both the Republic and the Empire sent in their strike teams, CZ-198 facility's defenses proved insufficient against them, and in the battle for the moon Rasmus was killed.<ref name="Flashpoint" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rasmus Blys first appeared in Game Update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]].<ref name="Flashpoint" />
